description: This file sets up an Express server that serves static files and provides API endpoints for database management and visualization. It includes database connection configuration for multiple database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB), database adapters for each, and logic to load environment variables and test database connections.
external_files: .env files for postgres, mysql, sqlite, mongodb (e.g., postgres.env, mysql.env, sqlite.env, mongodb.env)

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for database adapters, providing interface methods and helper functions.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Base class for SQL-based database adapters, extending DatabaseAdapter with execute and query methods.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from specific '.env' files for different databases, merging them with process.env.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to all configured databases and returns a list of those successfully connected.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests that operate on a database adapter.
